reason: The source diff replaces weighted search-selector storage and update paths, specializes DomOverWDeg and ActivityBased, and changes conflict-history bookkeeping. It targets solver variable selection and per-decision work, with a small parser call-site adjustment retained in the same source patch.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Specialized weight storage and selector updates may reduce per-decision overhead, while changed weighted scores can alter variable order, search tree size and proof time.
causal_chain: The PR removes generic watched-variable and value-map layers, adds identity-indexed weight storage, and rewrites DomOverWDeg and ActivityBased updates on conflicts and restarts. These values determine the next CP variable, so both local cost and global search trajectory can change.
structural_trigger: A CP task using dom-over-weighted-degree or activity-based variable selection that experiences propagation failures and repeated decisions; input-order search and trivially solved cases are controls.
activation_probe: On both pinned source states, trace weighted-selector calls, conflict/restart updates, chosen variable sequence, decisions, failures and nodes; verify the corresponding input-order control does not use the changed selectors.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze public balanced subset-sum and graph-coloring cases by generator, size and baseline difficulty before hidden scoring; retain weighted-search triggers and input-order controls, fixed seeds and budgets, and all timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared Choco exact driver and its configured search_strategy parameter; demonstrate direct DomOverWDeg or ActivityBased activation on a visible public panel and independently check original-problem solutions.
mathematical_risk: A selector may choose an instantiated or absent variable, lose search completeness, or corrupt conflict weights and incorrectly claim optimality or exhaust resources.
independent_check_plan: Verify each original CP solution, objective and integrality; compare optimality claims with independent dynamic-programming or graph certificates on tractable cases; retain contradictory and timeout statuses.
hidden_generalization_plan: Compare independently verified solve coverage, proof time and normal timeouts on paired held-out subset-sum and graph-coloring families across fixed seeds, reporting strategy and family regressions.
overlap_review: Choco #1152 changes search-decision path construction at an earlier snapshot, while #1178 changes arithmetic propagation later. This PR is one mixed selector-storage and scoring change; its classes and search strategies are one task, not separate PR counts.
resource_risk: Faster score updates may still expand the search tree or increase retained weight-state memory; different variable order can worsen exact proof time.
